experiment: Conditional recovery after the central 2039 financing boundary

recovery.fiscal_adjustment: constant share of contemporaneous GDP, phased in linearly over 16 quarters
recovery.inflation_path: piecewise path specified in the experiment script
recovery.new_issuance_rate_path: piecewise normalization path specified in the experiment script
recovery.real_growth_path: piecewise path specified in the experiment script
recovery.target: 2056Q3 debt/GDP no higher than 2039Q2 and no more than a 0.1 percentage-point increase over the final four quarters

warnings: Post-settlement growth, inflation, and marginal Treasury rates are conditional assumptions, not outputs of the sequential feedback rule.
The fiscal adjustment is solved to meet a declared terminal debt target; it is a required magnitude, not a forecast of legislation.
The cohort engine endogenously calculates rollover, coupons, TIPS indexation, interest expense, gross issuance, and debt under those paths.
Behavioral responses, distribution, bank recapitalization, investor demand, and political implementation remain outside the recovery run.
